import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Scan the parquet file lazily using polars backend
lf = pl.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Wrap with narwhals and build the lazy pipeline
df = (
    nw.from_native(lf)
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select(["user", "duration"])
    .collect()
    .to_native()
)

print(df)
